questions.question: Through the prophet Jeremiah, why did the LORD say Jerusalem and the cities of Judah lay in ruins?

answers.text: Because of the evil they had done
Because their walls were built too weak
Because their army was far too small

questions.question: When Jeremiah gave the Jews living in Egypt the LORD's warning, what did the great crowd answer him?

answers.text: We will not listen to you
We will do all you say

questions.question: The Jews in Egypt said they once burned incense to the Queen of Heaven in Judah. What did they say life was like then?

answers.text: Plenty of food and no disaster

questions.question: Through Jeremiah, what did the LORD say would happen to Pharaoh Hophra, the king of Egypt?

answers.text: He would be handed to his enemies
He would send Judah back home
